records.context: Used by :func:`spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment` and :func:`spacr.submodules.analyze_replication` (``panels`` / ``figures`` settings), and usable on any table with one row per object.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#1
records.source: Used by :func:`spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment` and :func:`spacr.submodules.analyze_replication` (``panels`` / ``figures`` settings), and usable on any table with one row per object.

records.context: **Experimental unit.** Objects are averaged per microplate sample position (``plateID``, ``rowID``, ``columnID``), and microplate sample position means are averaged per replicate when a replicate column is given (:func:`aggregate_to_unit`). Tests run on these unit values, never on individual cells, so the n of a test is the number of microplate sample positions or replicates.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#2
records.source: **Experimental unit.** Objects are averaged per well (``plateID``, ``rowID``, ``columnID``), and well means are averaged per replicate when a replicate column is given (:func:`aggregate_to_unit`). Tests run on these unit values, never on individual cells, so the n of a test is the number of wells or replicates.
records.translation: **Tilraunaeining.** Meðaltal hluta er tekið fyrir hvern brunn (``plateID``, ``rowID``, ``columnID``), og meðaltal brunnmeðaltala fyrir hverja endurtekningu þegar endurtekningardálkur er gefinn (:func:`aggregate_to_unit`). Próf keyra á þessum einingagildum, aldrei á einstökum frumum, svo n prófs er fjöldi brunna eða endurtekninga.

records.context: **Test selection for bar panels** (:func:`select_and_run_test`, one test per panel):
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#3
records.source: **Test selection for bar panels** (:func:`select_and_run_test`, one test per panel):
records.translation: **Val prófs fyrir súlumyndhluta** (:func:`select_and_run_test`, eitt próf á hvern myndhluta):

records.context: Shapiro-Wilk normality per group (groups with fewer than 3 values or no spread count as normal) and Levene equal variance (median centred, the Brown-Forsythe variant);
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#4
records.source: Shapiro-Wilk normality per group (groups with fewer than 3 values or no spread count as normal) and Levene equal variance (median centred, the Brown-Forsythe variant);
records.translation: Shapiro-Wilk normaldreifingarpróf fyrir hvern hóp (hópar með færri en 3 gildi eða enga dreifingu teljast normaldreifðir) og Levene-próf á jafnri dreifni (miðjað á miðgildi, Brown-Forsythe afbrigðið);

records.context: every group normal and equal variance: one-way ANOVA, post hoc Tukey HSD;
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#5
records.source: every group normal and equal variance: one-way ANOVA, post hoc Tukey HSD;
records.translation: allir hópar normaldreifðir með jafna dreifni: einhliða ANOVA, eftirápróf Tukey HSD;

records.context: every group normal, unequal variance: Welch ANOVA, post hoc Games-Howell;
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#6
records.source: every group normal, unequal variance: Welch ANOVA, post hoc Games-Howell;
records.translation: allir hópar normaldreifðir, ójöfn dreifni: Welch ANOVA, eftirápróf Games-Howell;

records.context: any group non-normal: Kruskal-Wallis, post hoc Dunn test with Holm correction.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#7
records.source: any group non-normal: Kruskal-Wallis, post hoc Dunn test with Holm correction.
records.translation: einhver hópur ekki normaldreifður: Kruskal-Wallis, eftirápróf Dunn með Holm leiðréttingu.

records.context: **Proportion panels** (:func:`proportion_tests`): object counts per bin, pooled over replicates, compared with a chi-square test of independence or the Fisher-Freeman-Halton exact test (Monte Carlo over tables with the observed margins; the Fisher exact test for a 2 x 2 table). The omnibus test covers every group; each group is also compared with the reference group (Holm correction). Cramer V is the effect size. These tests treat every object as independent, so with thousands of objects they flag small shifts; the replicate-level bar panel drawn next to them is the conservative test.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#8
records.source: **Proportion panels** (:func:`proportion_tests`): object counts per bin, pooled over replicates, compared with a chi-square test of independence or the Fisher-Freeman-Halton exact test (Monte Carlo over tables with the observed margins; the Fisher exact test for a 2 x 2 table). The omnibus test covers every group; each group is also compared with the reference group (Holm correction). Cramer V is the effect size. These tests treat every object as independent, so with thousands of objects they flag small shifts; the replicate-level bar panel drawn next to them is the conservative test.
records.translation: **Hlutfallsmyndhlutar** (:func:`proportion_tests`): fjöldi hluta í hverju bili, sameinaður yfir endurtekningar, borinn saman með kí-kvaðrat-prófi á óhæði eða nákvæmu Fisher-Freeman-Halton prófi (Monte Carlo yfir töflur með sömu jaðargildum og mælt var; nákvæmt Fisher-próf fyrir 2 x 2 töflu). Heildarprófið nær yfir alla hópa; hver hópur er einnig borinn saman við viðmiðunarhópinn (Holm leiðrétting). Cramer V er áhrifastærðin. Þessi próf meðhöndla hvern hlut sem óháðan, svo með þúsundum hluta merkja þau litlar hliðranir; súlumyndhlutinn á endurtekningastigi sem teiknaður er við hlið þeirra er íhaldssama prófið.

records.context: **Panel layout on disk** (:func:`save_panel`): one folder per panel, ``<out_dir>/<Pnn>_<name>/`` holding ``<Pnn>_<name>.pdf`` and ``.png``, ``data_replicates.csv`` (the plotted unit values), ``stats_test.csv``, ``stats_assumptions.csv``, ``stats_posthoc.csv`` and ``stats_descriptive.csv`` for bar panels, and ``contingency_table_counts.csv`` for stacked panels.

records.context: **Aligned order.** Every panel takes ``order`` (the x-axis order) from :func:`condition_order`, so a condition sits at the same place in every panel of a figure, and ``labels`` (raw value -> display label; underscores become spaces when no label is given). ``annotations`` draws aligned text rows under the x axis, for example a +/- table of what each condition contains.
records.label: spacr.assay_panels#10
records.source: **Aligned order.** Every panel takes ``order`` (the x-axis order) from :func:`condition_order`, so a condition sits at the same place in every panel of a figure, and ``labels`` (raw value -> display label; underscores become spaces when no label is given). ``annotations`` draws aligned text rows under the x axis, for example a +/- table of what each condition contains.
records.translation: **Samræmd röð.** Hver myndhluti fær ``order`` (röðina á x-ásnum) frá :func:`condition_order`, svo skilyrði er á sama stað í öllum myndhlutum myndar, og ``labels`` (hrátt gildi -> birtingarmerki; undirstrik verða að bilum þegar ekkert merki er gefið). ``annotations`` teiknar samræmdar textaraðir undir x-ásnum, til dæmis +/- töflu yfir hvað hvert skilyrði inniheldur.

records.translation: Myndhlutar til birtingar og viðbótarsíur (allt valkvætt; séu þær látnar standa á sjálfgefnum gildum helst úttakið hér að ofan óbreytt):

records.context: ``panels`` — list of key-value mappings, one bar panel each: ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group': column, 'order': list, 'labels': dict, 'annotations': {row: {group value: text}}, 'value': 'recruitment' or any numeric column, 'ymin', 'title', 'ylabel'}``. ``group`` may be any annotated column (``host_cells``, ``pathogen``, ``treatment``, ``condition``, or a column of your own). Ratio values are drawn from y = 1 when every unit value is at least 1. Panel ``i`` is saved as ``results/panels/Pnn_<name>/`` with ``<Pnn_name>.pdf/.png``, ``data_replicates.csv``, ``stats_test.csv``, ``stats_assumptions.csv``, ``stats_posthoc.csv`` and ``stats_descriptive.csv``. The test is chosen per panel (one-way ANOVA + Tukey HSD, Welch ANOVA + Games-Howell, or Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn test); see :mod:`spacr.assay_panels`.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment#20
records.source: ``panels`` — list of dicts, one bar panel each: ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group': column, 'order': list, 'labels': dict, 'annotations': {row: {group value: text}}, 'value': 'recruitment' or any numeric column, 'ymin', 'title', 'ylabel'}``. ``group`` may be any annotated column (``host_cells``, ``pathogen``, ``treatment``, ``condition``, or a column of your own). Ratio values are drawn from y = 1 when every unit value is at least 1. Panel ``i`` is saved as ``results/panels/Pnn_<name>/`` with ``<Pnn_name>.pdf/.png``, ``data_replicates.csv``, ``stats_test.csv``, ``stats_assumptions.csv``, ``stats_posthoc.csv`` and ``stats_descriptive.csv``. The test is chosen per panel (one-way ANOVA + Tukey HSD, Welch ANOVA + Games-Howell, or Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn test); see :mod:`spacr.assay_panels`.
records.translation: ``panels`` — listi af orðabókum, einn súlumyndhluti fyrir hverja: ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group': column, 'order': list, 'labels': dict, 'annotations': {row: {group value: text}}, 'value': 'recruitment' or any numeric column, 'ymin', 'title', 'ylabel'}``. ``group`` getur verið hvaða merktur dálkur sem er (``host_cells``, ``pathogen``, ``treatment``, ``condition`` eða eigin dálkur). records.translation: ``confounder_filter`` — ``{column: [min, max]}`` á hlutastigi, eða ``{column: {'quantiles': [lo, hi] | 'range': [min, max], 'level': 'object' | 'well'}}``. records.context: ``panels`` — list of key-value mappings ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group', 'order', 'labels', 'annotations', 'reference' (default the first group in the order), 'title', 'n_resamples'}``. Each entry gives three panels: the bins (parasites per vacuole, or size-proxy volume bins) stacked as mean ± SD of replicate (or well) fractions with a chi-square test, the same with the Fisher-Freeman-Halton exact test (Monte Carlo, Fisher exact test for 2 x 2), each with stars for every group against the reference (Holm), and a bar panel of the replicate mean of the per-vacuole value (mean parasites per vacuole, or mean vacuole area) with the test chosen as in :mod:`spacr.assay_panels`. Written to ``<src>/results/analyze_replication/panels/Pnn_<name>_.../`` with PDF, PNG, ``data_replicates.csv``, ``stats_test.csv``, ``contingency_table_counts.csv`` (stacked) or the assumption, post hoc and descriptive tables (bar).
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_replication#17
records.source: ``panels`` — list of dicts ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group', 'order', 'labels', 'annotations', 'reference' (default the first group in the order), 'title', 'n_resamples'}``. Each entry gives three panels: the bins (parasites per vacuole, or size-proxy volume bins) stacked as mean ± SD of replicate (or well) fractions with a chi-square test, the same with the Fisher-Freeman-Halton exact test (Monte Carlo, Fisher exact test for 2 x 2), each with stars for every group against the reference (Holm), and a bar panel of the replicate mean of the per-vacuole value (mean parasites per vacuole, or mean vacuole area) with the test chosen as in :mod:`spacr.assay_panels`. Written to ``<src>/results/analyze_replication/panels/Pnn_<name>_.../`` with PDF, PNG, ``data_replicates.csv``, ``stats_test.csv``, ``contingency_table_counts.csv`` (stacked) or the assumption, post hoc and descriptive tables (bar).
records.translation: ``panels`` — listi af orðabókum ``{'name', 'where': {column: value or list}, 'group', 'order', 'labels', 'annotations', 'reference' (default the first group in the order), 'title', 'n_resamples'}``. Hver færsla gefur þrjá myndhluta: bilin (sníkjudýr á hverja safabólu, eða rúmmálsbil stærðarstaðgengils) stöfluð sem meðaltal ± SD hlutfalla endurtekninga (eða brunna) með kí-kvaðrat-prófi, það sama með nákvæmu Fisher-Freeman-Halton prófi (Monte Carlo, nákvæmt Fisher-próf fyrir 2 x 2), hvort tveggja með stjörnum fyrir hvern hóp miðað við viðmiðunarhópinn (Holm), og súlumyndhluta með meðaltali endurtekninga á gildinu fyrir hverja safabólu (meðalfjöldi sníkjudýra á safabólu, eða meðalflatarmál safabólu) þar sem prófið er valið eins og í :mod:`spacr.assay_panels`. Skrifað í ``<src>/results/analyze_replication/panels/Pnn_<name>_.../`` með PDF, PNG, ``data_replicates.csv``, ``stats_test.csv``, ``contingency_table_counts.csv`` (staflað) eða töflum yfir forsendur, eftirápróf og lýsandi tölfræði (súlur).
